source.title: Disenchanting Advisor 1.0.2 source audit: actual SavedVariables aggregation and missing zero-inclusive/item-linked export
source.author: brandanq2

notes: Distinct primary-data acquisition audit, NOT an original processing study. Pinned third-party Retail/Midnight addon source holds in-memory source itemID, full hyperlink, quality, equipLoc and expansionID, but RecordResult persists only per-character expansionID, input quality and a 25-skill-point tier; tracking bucket contains attempts, matTotals by output itemID, matCounts by output itemID. Neither exact source itemID, ilvl/bonus itemLink, armor-vs-weapon, actual effective skill, specialization tree, version/hotfix, nor per-cast 0/1/2 output histogram is retained in the SavedVariables bucket. BAG_UPDATE_DELAYED calls RecordResult ONLY if known disenchant material is added and an equippable was removed/pending; attempts therefore omits unrecognized/true zero-output events and cannot establish a zero-inclusive completed-cast denominator. If one material is added in multiple bag slots in the same event, matCounts increments per entry, not necessarily unique cast-with-material. No public original per-character SavedVariables cohort/export was located. A sourced personal SavedVariables file may still supply lower-bound observed material quantities and recorded-result counts grouped by quality/25-skill tier, subject to independent verification and cohort/source dedupe; it CANNOT establish item 272246 ilvl305 eligibility. Public addon and its assumptions were previously noted in a research/mechanics source on main; no independent study is claimed. Earlier Cardinalai, JD3K, Honeybone, Draggoth, WoWhead Looter and max-skill Reddit cohorts deliberately not duplicated. No new casts, measured output hits, zero bins, rates or prices.
lookingFor: Original Midnight disenchant item-linked, completed-cast, per-output hit/zero/histogram SavedVariables exports; Miststalker's Wristbands 272246 305-ilvl successful output, Umbral Tin Ore 237362 and Tranquility Bloom 236761 raw operation logs
